title: Conversation Session State Transition v1
description: One observed transition of ConversationSession.status, triggered by one classified ConversationAction. The full lifecycle is IDLE, ACTIVE, WAITING_FOR_CLARIFICATION, PROPOSAL_READY, WAITING_FOR_ACCEPTANCE, CLOSED, FAILED — see docs/bible/14-conversation/373-conversation-session-lifecycle.md and 376-conversation-state-machine.md for the full Mermaid diagram. This schema validates one row of test-vectors/state-transition-vectors.json, generated by actually running ConversationEngine.process_turn() and observing session.status before/after, never hand-invented.

trigger.description: The ConversationActionType that caused this transition — see conversation-action.schema.json (inlined here, not $ref'd, matching every prior sprint's specs/*/v1/ convention).
